title: Kami Trials
notes: NEW: Kami Trials 神試練 after Master 99. Seven god bosses with their own mechanics: Fujin, Raijin, Tsukuyomi, Izanami, Susanoo, Hachiman, Amaterasu. First clear gives a guaranteed Godforged item.
Paragon is capped every 10 levels: beat the next Kami Trial to climb on. Paragon opponents get 6% stronger per level and give less XP, so it's a real climb now.
Determination: every loss against a god gives +3% damage against it (max +30%).
NEW: Endgame Goals board with progress for trials, Paragon, Rift, relics, uniques, Godforged, awakening and auras.
Master League and Paragon auto-continue with AUTO on: watch how far you get.
NEW: Talents have their own tab. Stat points show as a big badge.
New hero look: layered coat with element lining, armor, spiky anime hair, glowing eyes, curved katana with a glowing edge.
The Ultimate no longer covers the screen with its name. Missing relics are 4x more likely to drop. Blood Thirst shows when you're at the 12% lifesteal cap.
